name: Shibata Castle
description: Shibata Castle was the Mizoguchi domain seat. Unusually, its surviving 19th-century buildings include a three-story keep reconstruction, drum gate and water moat — one of Japan's rare castles with Edo-period gates remaining.
notes: The keep is a reconstruction; the Ote-mon gate is a designated cultural property.
